title: Radio listening, Hal Kemp and Ellington
summary: He stays up late listening to Ellington and Hal Kemp; talk of a Broadway show his brother took him to.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x:
The radio was just coming out
and I disobeyed all laws and stayed up until
the wee hours in grammar school, listening.
Ellington used to be on all the time. My
favorite of mine was Hal Kemp in those days.

Do you remember Hal Kemp from
North Carolina?

In the beginning
it was a dixieland band.
Yeah. It became society later; it was very collegiate.
I remember my brother taking me to see Tea for Two--No, No, Nanette.
Was she in the oririnal or was she in the revival a few years ago.
Yeah, she was the headliner of the revival.
No, I don't think it was Ruby Keeler; it was someone else.
